title: Need help developing my first horror game with AI
author: Grims_mods_468
selftext:
Hi, basically the title. 

I am new to AI and attempting to use AI to make games for my work. I think for a base before Human touch is a good idea to have. I do have a team of developers, assets and artists, but we don't have a lot of funding so I would like to use the funds for something productive.

Please recommend some resources, especially Other paid AI and for what tier of Claude to get for a department of video games. 

Also how do i make the games like we see on the page? 

In short: would like some manuals and videos to help me understand the process from start to finish. 

Best regards

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: I would start with a $20 plan and experiment but not start your main game right away. Don’t expect it to be easy or quick if you want quality. Honestly I would outline what you want out of the game and ask what game engine options are best. If you can’t make assets there are plenty of tutorials here and YouTube to source them or get them made with blender. Of course you have to decide on the art style. Honestly I’d say the first thing to do is pay anthropic $20 and say “make game” and make a test game or two while you get to know the tech and get to planning your main game. I know lots of people use blender and various game engines. Claude loves to just make java / browser games. Gpt is another good sub.
